# Reference Viewport Baseline

The approved comparison viewports are 1440x900, 1024x768, 768x1024, 390x844,
and 844x390. The baseline is behavior-only: capture the reference shell after
its dependencies are installed, then capture the Roaminal shell with the same
Chrome channel and viewport list. Do not copy reference images into runtime
assets.

For each viewport record login visibility, sidebar/terminal proportions,
terminal canvas presence, search controls, touch controls, overflow, and
console errors. Roaminal acceptance screenshots belong in the implementation
evidence directory and are never served by the application.
